description: Run a released scientific capability with exact inputs and destination. Validates internally, then queues one job. Requires authorization and compute entitlements. Retain the UUID for retries; inspect request_status after uncertainty.

idempotency_key.description: One UUID retained for this logical mutation and its retries.

limits.description: Optional maximum cost and resources; missing estimates block execution. 1000 cpu_millis = 1 vCPU.

parameters.description: Capability-specific values under the field name parameters (not params). Call get_capability first and validate against its parameters_schema.

name: run_capability
title: Run capability
